source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 23ης Μαΐου — «Άγιοι Δονατιανός και Ρογατιανός οι αυτάδελφοι οι Μάρτυρες»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 23 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The life page carries both brothers under two head lines, so this is a company of two named men and therefore two folders. The corpus keeps no Donatian. The page dates the arrest by the reign — «κατά τους χρόνους του αυτοκράτορα Διοκλητιανού (284 - 305 μ.Χ.)» — and gives no year of death, so the interval recorded is that reign as the page prints it. Its closing dates are the relics' and not his: a church raised at the burial place towards the end of the fifth century and a translation to the cathedral of Nantes in 1145. No hymn.
